scope: Delegation and retained-work ledger; not a native test, acceptance or publication certificate
snapshot_basis: Integrator confirmed all 60 distinct successful assignments and actual final worker notifications; all receipt bodies rehashed before publication
counting_rules: The integrator is not one of the 60 delegated workers.
A follow-up turn reuses the original worker identity and does not increment the count.
A failed spawn request creates no worker and is excluded.
A planned task name is not a spawned or completed worker.
Receipt identities and hashes describe retained work; each receipt retains its own source/test/native-execution scope.
No ledger or receipt hash is used as proof that a native run occurred.

failed_spawn_requests.observed_event: The first W09F spawn request hit the concurrency cap; the successful W09F assignment is counted exactly once.
